name: resource-observer-order
goal: Preserve fast native Bun exits and output when process-table probes synchronously yield child events

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Retain fast native child output and exit even when its first process-table observation blocks for 150 milliseconds.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard native Bun and Node runner matrix delayed spawn observers but not the first process-table observation. Add that input to the same matrix.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Accepted immutable failing checkpoint 603444fcab370bcce417e5cef3f2248d19657b81; tests were committed before product repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Install stream and exit handlers before the first descendants observation; retain bounded ownership cleanup.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Accepted unchanged-test passing checkpoint 3572a10a55bdfebf3f28afa952156811bf217c42 with its retained paired red record.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: The unchanged native observer matrix passes. Valid focused capture retains timing and RSS for all 43 executable queue units; global checks remain separate.
